name: tradepilot212
description: Trading 212 portfolio analytics, pies, rebalancing, protective orders, investment plans, price alerts, and human-confirmed order baskets over a local MCP server.

sample_data.title: Try with sample data
sample_data.description: Use a simulated Demo account instead of Trading 212, so you can try every feature without an API key. Live is off and the keys above are ignored while this is on.

t212_demo_api_key.title: Trading 212 Demo API key
t212_demo_api_key.description: Practice-account key. Leave empty if unused.

t212_demo_api_secret.title: Trading 212 Demo API secret
t212_demo_api_secret.description: Shown once when you create the Demo key.

t212_live_api_key.title: Trading 212 Live API key
t212_live_api_key.description: Real-money key. A key without order permissions keeps the plugin read-only at the broker.

t212_live_api_secret.title: Trading 212 Live API secret
t212_live_api_secret.description: Shown once when you create the Live key.

default_environment.title: Default environment
default_environment.description: Used when a request does not say demo or live.

allow_writes.title: Enable order tools
allow_writes.description: Off by default. When on, the model can draft orders and the order execution tools become callable; only enable it in a host that asks you before each tool call.

max_order_notional.title: Max order value
max_order_notional.description: Per-order value cap in your account currency. 0 disables it.

demo_automation.title: Run Demo plans unattended
demo_automation.description: Lets due Demo investment plans marked autoExecute place orders without asking. Needs order tools enabled. Live plans always wait for you.

notify_webhook_url.title: Notification webhook
notify_webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS address, or several separated by spaces (Slack, Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Bark or your own), that receives due plans, fills and price alerts while the plugin is running.

notify_locale.title: Notification language
notify_locale.description: The language notifications are written in.

quote_provider.title: Quote source
quote_provider.description: Prices for instruments you do not hold. stooq is free with no key; finnhub, twelvedata and alphavantage need a key; none turns it off.

quote_api_key.title: Quote API key
quote_api_key.description: Only for finnhub, twelvedata or alphavantage.
